blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: For many computer vision tasks, neural networks can be trained to produce a low average error, yet they still fail on seemingly simple scenes. Reducing these failures requires first finding them, but they may not be in a fixed dataset. We study procedural adversarial learning (PAL), a framework of minimax training and adversarial evaluation which searches the input space of a procedural generator for difficult instances. The procedural generator is an interpretable program mapping a low-dimensional vector of control parameters (e.g. layout, lighting, pose) to a rendered image and its label. We introduce the Simple-PAT algorithm, which uses zeroth-order optimization in the procedural generator's parameter space to propose adversarial training samples that are generated on demand. We also create PAL-Dojo, a collection of efficient procedural generators for surface normal estimation, image segmentation, and human pose estimation. Against a cross-model black-box adversary with 50M aggregate queries, Simple-PAT reduces worst-case error by a geometric mean of 3.15x compared to standard training and 2.63x compared to the strongest robust training baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/princeton-vl/procedural-adversarial-learning.
blocks.zh: 对于许多计算机视觉任务来说,神经网络可以被训练来产生较低的平均误差,然而它们仍然在看似简单的场景上失败. 减少这些故障需要首先找到它们,但可能不是在固定数据集中。 我们研究程序性对抗学习(PAL),这是一种小型培训和对抗性评价的框架,用于搜索程序生成器的输入空间,以应对困难的情况。 程序生成器是一个可解释的程序,将低维矢量的控制参数(如布局,照明,姿势)映射到渲染的图像及其标签上. 我们引入了Simple-PAT算法,该算法在程序生成器的参数空间中采用零序优化,提出根据需求生成的对抗性训练样本. 我们还创建了PAL-Dojo,这是一个高效的程序生成器集合,用于表面正常估计,图像分解,以及人类姿势估计. 面对一个拥有50M汇总查询的跨型黑箱对手,Simple-PAT将最坏情况误差减少,比标准训练的几何平均值为3.15x,比最强强强的训练基线的2.63x. 守则见https://github.com/princeton-vl/程序-对抗-学习。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision models deployed in the wild are often relied on to produce high-quality predictions in all situations. This is particularly important for self-driving cars, surgical robots, and heavy machinery, where failures in perception can lead to dangerous and costly mistakes. However, even well-trained neural networks often fail on simple scenes or natural adversarial examples ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Alcorn et al., 2019 ) . This is not easily solved by scaling data or model size, as foundation VLMs also struggle on examples that are easy for humans ( Li et al., 2024 ) . These failures motivate training and evaluation techniques that explicitly account for worst-case error.
blocks.zh: 部署在野外的远景模型常常被依赖来在所有情况下产生高质量的预测. 这对自驾汽车,外科机器人和重型机械来说尤其重要,因为在那里,感想的失败会导致危险而昂贵的错误. 然而,即使是训练有素的神经网络也常常在简单的场景或自然对抗性的例子上失败(Hendrycks等,2021;Alcorn等,2019). 这不容易通过缩放数据或模型大小来解决,因为基础VLMs也为人类容易的例子而挣扎(Li等,2024年). 这些失败促使培训和评价技术明确造成最坏情况出错。

blocks.en: How can we train a model that has low worst-case error? A natural and established idea is to define a minimax learning objective: minimizing the worst-case error, defined as the maximum error over all possible instances of the task space. While simple to state, this minimax objective is challenging to operationalize: typically, we are given a fixed finite sample of the task instances such as a set of labeled images. This sample does not allow us to reliably estimate the maximum error over all possible images since failure cases may be unseen. If we cannot reliably measure the worst case error, we cannot reliably improve it.
blocks.zh: 我们如何训练一个有低最坏错误的模型? 一个自然而成熟的想法是定义一个最小的学习目标:将最坏情况错误最小化,定义为任务空间所有可能实例的最大错误. 这个微型目标虽然简单易行,但难以实现:通常,我们获得一个固定的有限任务实例样本,如一组贴有标签的图像。 这个样本使我们无法可靠地估计所有可能图像的最大出错,因为故障情况可能无法发现。 如果我们不能可靠地衡量最严重的错误,我们就无法可靠地改进它。

blocks.en:
To discover missed failure modes and reduce worst-case error, prior work in robust and adversarial machine learning has attempted to perturb existing images (e.g. Goodfellow et al. (2015) ; Engstrom et al. (2019) ; Hosseini and Poovendran (2018) ). However, such perturbations are usually limited to simple transformations such as color jitter and spatial cropping, and cover only a tiny subset of valid image transformations.
This is because automatically generating physically valid perturbations of existing images that span viewpoint changes, dynamic lighting, and shape deformation remains an active research challenge plagued by its own failure modes. On the other hand, collecting additional real-world data can be slow and expensive.
blocks.zh:
为了发现错失的故障模式并减少最坏情况出错,以往在强力和对抗性机器学习方面的工作曾试图扰乱现有图像(如Goodfellow等人(2015年);Engstrom等人(2019年);Hosseini和Poovendran (2018年))。 然而,这种扰动通常仅限于色彩焦躁和空间收割等简单的变相,并只覆盖一个很小的子集的有效图像变相.
这是因为,自动产生物理上有效的扰动现有图像,这些图像跨越视角变化、动态照明和形状变形,仍然是受到其自身故障模式困扰的一个积极研究挑战。 另一方面,收集更多的现实世界数据可能缓慢而昂贵。

blocks.en:
Thus, a key challenge of improving worst-case error lies in scalable discovery and generation of failure cases.
In this work, we address this with Procedural Adversarial Learning (PAL), a framework consisting of procedural adversarial training (PAT) and procedural adversarial evaluation (PAE); the key idea is to adversarially select samples using a procedural generator.
During training, a learner updates the parameters of the network while an adversary searches for the worst case. For evaluation, a strong adversary searches the procedural parameter space for the task configuration that is most challenging for the model.
blocks.zh:
因此,改善最坏情况错误的一个关键挑战在于可扩展的发现和产生失败案例。
在这项工作中,我们用程序对抗学习(PAL)来解决这一问题,这是一个由程序对抗训练和程序对抗评价(PAE)组成的框架;关键的想法是使用程序生成器进行对抗选择样本.
在训练期间,一名学习者更新网络参数,而对手则寻找最坏的情况。 就评价而言,一个强大的对手为任务组合搜索程序参数空间,而任务配置对模型最具挑战性。

blocks.en:
A procedural generator generates data through interpretable code: an image of a tree can be procedurally generated from scratch by code that simulates tree growth, bark material, light transport, and perspective projection. Procedural generation can create diverse photorealistic images ( Raistrick et al., 2023 ; Raistrick et al., 2024 ) , visual ground truth, and useful training data ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) .
Importantly, procedural generation enables scalable discovery and generation of failure cases. A well-designed procedural generator can offer a combination of properties unavailable from image-space perturbation: (1) wide coverage of task instances, (2) physically valid perturbations, (3) a small number of control parameters that help traverse the task space, (4) on-demand generation of new task instances.
blocks.zh:
程序生成器通过可解释代码生成数据:一棵树的图像可以通过模拟树生长,树皮材料,光传输,和视角投影的代码从抓取程序生成. 程序生成可以创造出多样的相片现实化图像(Raistrick等,2023;Raistrick等,2024),视觉地平面真相,以及有用的训练数据(Ma等,2026;Yan等,2026).
重要的是,程序生成有助于可扩展的发现和生成失败案例。 设计良好的程序生成器可以提供从图像-空间扰动中无法获取的属性的组合:(1) 任务实例的广泛覆盖,(2) 物理上有效的扰动,(3) 少数有助于穿越任务空间的控制参数,(4) 按需生成新的任务实例.

blocks.en:
These properties make procedural generators an especially strong tool for PAL, since we can effectively search a visually complex collection of scenes. This distinguishes PAL from conventional adversarial learning, which searches a limited set of image perturbations. The evaluation also distinguishes PAL from Adversarial Domain Randomization ( Khirodkar and Kitani, 2021 ) , which trains with the same minimax formulation over a simulator’s parameters but evaluates mean performance in a target domain.
In PAL, training seeks to minimize the worst case under the generator and evaluation searches for it directly. The challenge lies in developing training algorithms that reliably improve the worst case. This can be particularly difficult when failures occupy only a small region of the parameter space, or when learning one failure causes the model to forget scenes it previously handled.
blocks.zh:
这些属性使得程序生成器成为PAL特别强大的工具,因为我们可以有效地搜索一个视觉上复杂的场景集合. 这区分了PAL和常规的对抗性学习,后者搜索了有限的一组图像扰动. 该评价还区分了PAL与Adversarial Domain Randomization(Khirodkar and Kitani, 2021),后者在模拟器的参数上用同样的微型马克思配方进行训练,但评价了目标域中的平均性能.
在PAL中,培训旨在尽量减少发电机下最坏的情况,并直接对它进行评价搜索。 挑战在于制定能够可靠地改善最坏情况的培训算法。 当失败只占据了参数空间的一个小区域,或者当学习一次失败导致模型忘记它以前处理过的场景时,这可能会特别困难.

blocks.en: Figure 1: We compare Simple-PAT to training methods that uniformly sample data for each minibatch. Left: Simple-PAT reduces worst-case error more effectively than uniform training and alternative methods. Right: Simple-PAT models perform much better on cases uniformly trained models found challenging. Uniform refers to the “Uniform (Muon)” setting, which is the stronger of the uniform training methods.
blocks.zh: 图1:我们比较了Simple-PAT与培训方法,这些方法统一了每个小批量的样本数据. 左:简单-PAT比统一训练和替代方法更有效地减少最坏情况错误. 对:简单-PAT模型在被发现具有挑战性的情况下, 统一是指“统一(Muon)”的设置,这是统一培训方法中最强的。

blocks.en: We propose Simple-PAT, a simple algorithm for procedural adversarial training using adversaries that attack via zeroth-order optimization. Simple-PAT consists of a learner that trains the model through minibatch gradient descent and an adversary that uses Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) Hansen and Ostermeier (2001) to search on procedural controls to generate the next minibatch based on existing cases the model finds challenging.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Simple-PAT,一种简单的程序对抗训练的算法,利用对手通过零顺序优化进行攻击. Simple-PAT包括一个通过小批量梯度下降来训练模型的学习者,以及一个利用Covariance Matrix适应进化战略(CMA-ES)Hansen和Ostermeier(2001年)搜索程序控制以生成下一个基于模型认为具有挑战性的现有案例的小批量的对手.

blocks.en: To analyze PAT algorithms, we develop PAL-Dojo, a suite of procedural generators for three vision tasks: surface normal estimation, human pose estimation, and image segmentation. We design these generators to control the scenes’ layout, lighting, shapes, and poses using between 13 and 69 parameters. We prioritize simplicity and efficiency of generation to facilitate algorithmic development.
blocks.zh: 为了分析PAT算法,我们开发了PAL-Dojo,一套程序生成器,用于三种视觉任务:表面正常估计,人姿估计,和图像分解. 我们设计这些发电机是为了控制场景的布局,照明,外形和姿势,使用13到69个参数. 我们优先重视简单和高效的发电,以促进算法发展。

blocks.en: We evaluate trained models on PAL-Dojo by treating them as a black box and adversarially attacking with a large query budget. We use a single-model adversary with 2M queries and a cross-model adversary with a total of 50M queries. In Figure 1 , we compare Simple-PAT to a naive learner that samples every batch uniformly from the parameter space (uniform training), and to two methods that reweight uniform samples based on their loss (CVaR and tilted ERM). Under the cross-model adversary, Simple-PAT lowers the worst case on every task, by a geometric mean of 3.15 × 3.15\times relative to uniform training and 2.63 × 2.63\times relative to the strongest other method on each task. We also evaluate the robustness of SOTA foundation models using the PAL-Dojo generators, finding severe failure cases with our adversary. This demonstrates that PAL-Dojo, though visually simple, provides sufficient challenge to SOTA models.
blocks.zh: 我们评价PAL-Dojo上的训练有素的模型, 把它们当作一个黑匣子, 我们使用一个有2M查询的单型对手和一个共有5M查询的跨型对手. 在图1中,我们将Simple-PAT与一个天真的学习者进行比较,该学习者从参数空间(统一培训)中对每批样本进行统一取样,并将它与两种根据其损失重新加权统一样本的方法(CVAR和倾斜的机构风险管理)进行比较。 在跨模式的对手之下,Simple-PAT将每项任务中最糟糕的情况降低为:相对于统一训练的几何平均值为3.15×3.15分;相对于每项任务中最强的其他方法,2.63×2.63分。 我们还评估使用PAL-Dojo发电机的SOTA基础模型的稳健性,发现我们的对手有严重的故障。 这表明PAL-Dojo虽然视觉简单,但对SOTA模型提供了足够的挑战.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: (1) Procedural Adversarial Learning (PAL), a framework that pairs minimax training under a procedural generator with worst-case evaluation by an adaptive adversary; (2) Simple-PAT, a simple yet effective procedural adversarial training algorithm; (3) PAL-Dojo, a suite of simple, efficient but sufficiently hard procedural generators for vision tasks, designed to facilitate the study of PAL.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献有三: (1)程序反常学习(PAL),一个框架,将程序生成器下的小型最大培训与适应性对手的最坏情况评价相配; (2)简单-PAT,一个简单而有效的程序对抗性培训算法; (3)PAL-Dojo,一套简单而高效但足够硬的程序生成器,用于视觉任务,旨在便利PAL的研究.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Natural Adversarial Examples. Image classifiers and vision-language models are known to fail on unmodified natural images that humans label easily ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Search can also reveal these failures systematically, by adjusting the pose as in Alcorn et al. (2019) , or other elements including object placement and lighting ( Zeng et al., 2019 ; Leclerc et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 自然相向的例子。 已知图像分类器和视觉语言模型在人类容易标注的未经修改的自然图像上失败(Hendrycks等,2021;Li等,2024.). 搜索还可以通过调整Alcorn等人(2019年)的姿势,或者包括物体放置和照明在内的其他元素(Zeng等人,2019年;Leclerc等人,2022年),系统地揭示出这些故障.

blocks.en: Adversarial training and robust objectives. Classical adversarial examples were defined as small pixel perturbations ( Szegedy et al., 2014 ; Goodfellow et al., 2015 ) , and adversarial training addresses this by minimizing loss under perturbations within an L ∞ L^{\infty} ball around each image ( Madry et al., 2017 ) . However, these perturbations are limited and the inner optimization loop during training can be costly. Alternative methods instead emphasize difficult examples through a distributionally robust training objective. CVaR averages the worst α \alpha fraction of samples ( Rockafellar and Uryasev, 2000 ; Levy et al., 2020 ) , and tilted ERM weights each example in proportion to exp ⁡ ( β ​ ℓ ) \exp(\beta\ell) for a loss ℓ \ell and hyperparameter β \beta ( Li et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 横向培训和稳健目标。 典型的对抗性实例被定义为小像素扰动(Szegedy等,2014年;Goodfellow等,2015年),对抗性训练通过将每个图像周围的L-Q-L-infty 球内扰动所造成的损失降至最低来解决这个问题(Madry等,2017年)。 然而,这些扰动是有限的,培训期间的内在优化循环可能代价高昂. 替代方法则通过分布良好的培训目标来强调困难的例子。 CVaR平均为样本中最差的α-α分量(Rockafellar和Uryasev,2000;Levy等,2020;和倾斜的ERM权重,每个例子按XX(β l)\exp(\β\ell)的比例表示损失l和高参数β-β-β(Li等,2021年)。

blocks.en:
Adversaries in Reinforcement Learning and Control. Research in reinforcement learning has also searched for challenging training instances.
PAIRED trains a level generator to maximize the agent’s regret ( Dennis et al., 2020 ) . ACCEL applies random mutations to high-regret levels to generate new difficult instances ( Parker-Holder et al., 2022 ) . Importantly, both optimize regret instead of loss since directly optimizing loss would produce impossible tasks in their environments. Neither work attempts to evaluate the worst-case performance over the entire parameter space.
blocks.zh:
强化学习和控制方面的逆差。 强化学习方面的研究也探索了具有挑战性的培训实例。
PAIRED 培训一个水平生成器,以最大化代理的遗憾(Dennis等,2020年). ACCEL将随机突变应用于高Regret水平,以产生新的困难情况(Parker-Holder等,2022.). 重要的是,两者都优化遗憾而不是损失,因为直接优化损失将在其环境中产生无法完成的任务。 无论是哪种工作都试图评价整个参数空间上最糟糕的性能.

blocks.en: Adversarial game formulations have also been used to develop safe and robust learning-based controllers, through minimax policy training against disturbance forces ( Pinto et al., 2017 ) and safety control against worst-case disturbances ( Fisac et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 反常游戏配方也被用于通过针对扰动力量(平托等,2017年)和最坏情况扰动的安全控制(Fisac等,2018年)的微型政策培训来开发安全而强大的以学习为基础的控制器.

blocks.en:
Adversarial Domain Randomization. Adversarial Domain Randomization (ADR) ( Khirodkar and Kitani, 2021 ) trains a learner against a simulator in a minimax game, with a policy over quantized simulation parameters rewarded by the learner’s loss. In ADR’s experiments, this policy controls a few coarse parameters (e.g. object class and placement), while lighting, texture, and pose are randomly sampled.
ADR demonstrates that such a policy identifies distributions that produce useful samples, such as occluded objects and difficult placements, and outperforms domain randomization ( Tobin et al., 2017 ) on mean performance in the target domain. In contrast, PAL’s evaluation searches for the worst case in the same parameter space used for training.
blocks.zh:
逆域随机化. Aversarial Domain Randomization(ADR)(Khirodkar和Kitani,2021年)在微型游戏中训练一个学习者对抗一个模拟器,其政策是对被学习者的损失所奖励的量化模拟参数. 在ADR的实验中,这种政策控制了几个粗细的参数(如物体类和放置),而照明,纹理和姿势则随机抽样.
发展成果评估表明,这种政策确定可产生有用样本的分布,如被占有的物体和难以放置的样本,以及超过目标域平均性能的域随机化(Tobin等,2017年)。 相比之下,PAL的评价在培训所用的同一参数空间中寻找最坏的情况。

blocks.en: 3.1 Normal Estimation
blocks.zh: 3.1 正常估计

blocks.en: For the normal estimation task, the model must estimate the 3-dimensional surface normal vector at every pixel on a curved surface. This surface is a heightfield determined by a mixture of sinusoidal waves. The material is a checkerboard pattern rendered with Lambertian shading under a directional light with an ambient term. The presence of a repetitive checkerboard pattern makes normal estimation tractable, since any warping in the pattern is due to surface normal variation. The network must also learn to appropriately handle shadows and lighting cues.
blocks.zh: 对于正常的估算任务,模型必须估计曲线表面上每个像素的三维表面正常向量. 这个地表是一个由鼻波混合而成的高地. 材料是用Lambertian的阴影在带有环境术语的方向光下制成的跳板图案。 重复的检查板模式的存在使得正常的估计可被取用,因为模式中的任何摇摆都是由表面的正常变化所造成. 该网络还必须学会适当处理阴影和照明提示。

blocks.en: The generator has 25 parameters, with 13 parameters specifying the waves, 2 describing the light azimuth and elevation, and 10 describing the checkerboard texture. This includes 24 continuous parameters, and 1 discrete parameter specifying the number of waves.
blocks.zh: 生成器有25个参数,其中13个参数指定了波,2个参数描述了光方位角和高地,10个参数描述了检查板纹理. 这包括24个连续参数和1个指定波数的离散参数。

blocks.en: We use the metric of average angular error (in degrees) to describe models’ performance.
blocks.zh: 我们用平均角误差(以度计)来描述模型的性能。

blocks.en: 3.2 Object Segmentation
blocks.zh: 3.2 对象分割

blocks.en: Our object segmentation task asks models to classify each pixel as belonging to a chair object or not. The generator places chairs and distractor objects within a room while ensuring the chair is not occluded excessively. We have a Chair-Simple variant with 13 dimensions and a Chair-Full variant with 69 dimensions.
blocks.zh: 我们的对象分割任务要求模型将每个像素分类为是否属于椅子对象. 发电机将椅子和分心器物体放置在房间里,同时确保椅子不被过度占用。 我们有一个主席-简易变体,有13个维度,还有一个主席-简易变体,有69个维度。

blocks.en:
The procedural objects that can be placed in the room include chairs, tables, desks, and cubes. These objects are adapted from ProcFunc implementations of objects in Infinigen, with a custom backend designed for rapid generation ( Raistrick et al., 2026 ) .
To keep the dimensionality manageable, we map three parameters to the inputs of each object’s generator: one selects a discrete style, and two set all of its continuous inputs. We design this mapping so that uniform sampling reproduces Infinigen’s distribution of each input (i.e., the marginal distribution of each Infinigen parameter). However, since there are only three parameters, we cover fewer combinations of inputs than Infinigen’s independent sampling.
blocks.zh:
可放入会议室的程序对象包括椅子、桌子、桌子和立方体。 这些物体由ProcFunc在Infinigen对物体的实现而改编而来,有一个自定义后端,用于快速生成(Raistrick等,2026年).
为了保持维度的可控性,我们绘制了每个对象生成器输入的三个参数:一个选择了离散样式,两个选择了所有连续输入。 我们设计这个映射,以便统一取样复制Infinigen对每个输入的分布(即每个Infinigen参数的边际分布). 然而,由于只有三个参数,我们涵盖的投入组合比Infinigen的独立抽样要少。

blocks.en: In the Chair-Simple task, we have 5 parameters for the room shape and camera placement, and we have 8 parameters for the object type, shape, and position.
blocks.zh: 在主席-简易任务中,我们有5个参数用于房间形状和相机布置,还有8个参数用于物体类型、形状和位置。

blocks.en:
For the Chair-Full task, we place up to 8 objects on a 16 × 16 16\times 16 grid of positions on the floor. Each
object has a parameter d i d_{i} that selects a target cell, with cells ordered so that consecutive cells are
adjacent on the floor. Objects are placed sequentially. For object i i , we identify the valid grid cells given the objects already placed, and place the object in the valid cell nearest to its target cell.
We determine cell validity based on criteria of non-intersection, the boundaries of the room, and non-occlusion. We restrict occlusion to avoid the case where an object is visible but its class is not identifiable (e.g. a chair where you can only see its legs).
This arrangement procedure ensures that the problem is tractable, but also introduces discontinuities and sensitive parameters.

blocks.en: 3.3 Human Pose Estimation
blocks.zh: 3.3 人猪估计

blocks.en: The human pose estimation task builds on the scene generator from the object segmentation task. It includes three object slots, and one human slot.
blocks.zh: 人类的姿势估计任务建立在从物体分解任务产生的场景生成器上. 它包括三个物体槽和一个人槽.

blocks.en:
The human figure uses the Anny model with clothing from MakeHuman ( Brégier et al., 2026 ; MakeHuman Community, ) . We include five identity coordinates (gender, age, muscle, weight, proportions), and 9 pose coordinates.
For pose, we perform archetypal analysis dimensionality reduction on the poses from the CMU mocap database ( CMU Graphics Lab, ) , and we remove two archetypes with upside-down poses. The 9 pose coordinates determine the mixing weights on the remaining 10 archetypes.
Our goal is to represent plausible poses instead of every possible joint configuration, which would produce self-intersection and other non-physical configurations.

人类人物使用由Make Human(Brégier等,2026;Make Human Community,.)所出自的有衣物的Any模型. 我们包括五个身份坐标(性别、年龄、肌肉、体重、比例)和9个位置坐标。

我们的目标是代表合理的姿势,而不是每一种可能的联合配置,这种组合将产生自相交织和其他非物理配置。

blocks.en: 4 Adversarial Training
blocks.zh: 4 横向培训

blocks.en: We design our adversarial training procedure Simple-PAT around three principles: (1) coverage: the model must be presented with examples near the worst-case example (2) diversity: each batch the model receives should contain maximally distinct examples (3) computation reuse: samples which we render and evaluate should be used to update the network. Though simple, these principles allow us to design an algorithm whose training throughput is comparable to uniform training, while achieving a large reduction in evaluation worst-case error.
blocks.zh: 我们围绕三项原则设计对抗性培训程序: (1) 覆盖面:模型必须提供与最坏例子相近的例子(2) 多样性:模型收到的每批样本应包含最大程度独特的例子(3) 计算再利用:我们提供和评估的样本应用来更新网络。 这些原则虽然很简单,但使我们能够设计一种算法,其培训吞吐量可与统一培训相提并论,同时实现评价最坏情况错误的大幅减少。

We run a forward pass on every data point and use the results to update the CMA-ES parameters. We then run a backward pass and optimization step, as in standard neural network training. Every R R steps we reset the weakest CMA-ES instances as determined by a fitness function.

blocks.en: CMA-ES Optimization. CMA-ES is a zeroth-order optimizer that uses a multivariate normal distribution to sample candidate solutions to the optimization problem ( Hansen and Ostermeier, 2001 ) . This is amenable to our setup due to batched computation and diversity in samples. At each step, λ \lambda points are sampled from N ⁡ ( μ , Σ ) N(\mu,\Sigma) , these points are evaluated by fitness, and μ \mu and Σ \Sigma are updated. We constrain Σ \Sigma to be diagonal since λ \lambda is relatively small. For fitness, we use the evaluation metric of each task. This may differ from the training loss function due to stability or smoothness reasons.

blocks.en: We also change standard CMA-ES by pooling updates over 2 generation steps (i.e. μ \mu and Σ \Sigma are updated every other training step). This increases the number of samples used to compute the updates and captures some of the non-stationarity in the objective. If worst case is moving in parameter space due to neural network updates, this pooling operation discourages CMA-ES from over-concentrating at an optimum which exists only transiently.

blocks.en: 5 Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: On the PAL-Dojo tasks, we compare Simple-PAT adaptive training to training techniques that select samples uniformly at random.

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价

blocks.en: Our primary evaluation, procedural adversarial evaluation (PAE), is a worst-case search against each network after it has completed training; we describe this in the following subsections. The true worst case cannot be computed with a finite number of queries, so we use best-effort adversaries that probe each model as a black box subject to a compute budget, and we refer to the worst case an adversary finds as the evaluation worst case . We consider two PAE adversaries: a single-model adversary that searches against each model separately, and a cross-model adversary that pools the worst cases found across models. We also evaluate every model on the same test set of 65,536 scenes sampled uniformly at random.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要评价,即程序对抗性评价,是在每个网络完成培训后对它进行最坏的搜索;我们在以下分节中对此作了描述。 真正的最坏的情况不能用有限的查询数量来计算,所以我们用最优秀的对手来探测每个模型,作为一个受计算预算制约的黑匣子,我们把对手发现的最坏情况称为评价最坏的情况。 我们认为两个PAE对手:一个是单一模式的对手,分别针对每个模式进行搜索;另一个是跨模式的对手,集中了不同模式中发现的最坏情况。 我们还在65 536个场景的同一组测试中,对每个模型进行随机统一取样。

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Single-Model Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 单一模式评价

blocks.en: Our single-model evaluation protocol uses a black-box optimizer to search for the procedural parameters that produce the worst loss for a given network. We use a budget of 2 million queries, which represents 39 % 39\% of the overall training budget of 5.12 million samples. We split this between 1 million samples of a DIRECT-L search ( Gablonsky and Kelley, 2001 ) and 1 million samples of a CMA-ES search. This CMA-ES search differs from the search performed during training in several important ways: (1) it uses a population size of 512 instead of 28 (2) it updates a full covariance matrix instead of a diagonal parameterization (3) IPOP restarts are permitted (4) the objective is stationary, allowing for better convergence ( Hansen et al., 2019 ) . Combined, these settings give the evaluation a substantially more powerful search than training.
blocks.zh: 我们的单模型评价协议使用黑箱优化器来搜索给给定网络造成最坏损失的程序参数. 我们使用200万次查询的预算,占培训总预算512万份样本的39%。 我们把这分为100万个DIRECT-L搜索样本(Gablonsky和Kelley,2001年)和100万个CMA-ES搜索样本。 这种CMA-ES搜索与培训期间的搜索有几种重要不同:(1)它使用的人口规模为512,而不是28(2),它更新了完整的共变矩阵而不是对角参数化(3)IPOP重启是允许的(4),目标是固定的,可以更好的趋同(Hansen等人,2019年). 综合起来,这些环境使评价比培训更有力量。

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Cross-Model Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 跨模式评价

blocks.en: For our cross-model evaluation, we pool the worst cases across training seeds and training procedures. We evaluate each network on the worst cases found by the black-box optimizer against other networks. We report the overall worst loss among the single-model evaluation and the evaluation on other networks’ worst cases. In our experiments, we have five methods and 5 seeds per method. Thus, the cross-model evaluation has a total of 50M queries, though each model is still only queried 2M times.
blocks.zh: 在我们的跨模式评价中,我们汇集了培训种子和培训程序中最严重的案例。 我们评价每个网络 对于最坏的病例 黑盒优化者发现 相对于其他网络。 我们报告在单一模式评价和其他网络最坏情况的评价中损失最大。 在我们的实验中,我们有五个方法,每个方法有五个种子. 因此,跨模型评价共有50M个查询,尽管每个模式仍然只有2M次查询.

Under uniform sampling, the distribution is tightly concentrated around its mode of 19 samples per bin, consistent with a Poisson distribution. Under adversarial sampling, the mode is only 5 samples per bin, but with a long tail extending over several orders of magnitude. blocks.en: On the chair-full task, however, single-model searches missed difficult cases for the Simple-PAT models. The cross-model adversary increased Simple-PAT’s worst case by 2.65 × 2.65\times , compared with at most 1.58 × 1.58\times for the baselines. Given that chair-full is the task with the highest dimensionality (69 parameters), this is not surprising since the optimization problem is more challenging. This reveals the difficulty of evaluating the worst case in complex environments; we therefore report the cross-model evaluation as our primary metric, since pooling searches across models gives a stronger adversary.
blocks.zh: 然而,在主席全程任务方面,单型搜索错过了Simple-PAT模型的难题。 跨模型对手将Simple-PAT最坏的情况增加了2.65×2.65\时,而基线最多1.58×1.58\时。 鉴于全能是最高维度(69个参数)的任务,这并不奇怪,因为优化问题更具挑战性。 这揭示了在复杂环境中评价最坏情况的困难;因此,我们把跨模式评价作为我们的首要衡量标准,因为跨模式的搜索集中在一起,就更能对付对手。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We study procedural adversarial learning (PAL), in which a model is trained against an adversary that searches the parameters of a procedural generator, and is then judged by the worst case a strong adversary can find in that same space. We design a Simple-PAT algorithm that realizes this adversarial game with zeroth-order CMA-ES optimization on the parameter space. Across our four PAL-Dojo tasks, Simple-PAT improves the robustness over uniform training and robust reweighting variants. The cross-evaluation results suggest that there is shared structure between various training runs that is sometimes missed by black-box optimizers. Future work might exploit this structure to produce a stronger adversary and more robust models.
blocks.zh: 我们研究程序性对抗学习(PAL),在这种学习中,一个模型是针对一个搜索程序生成器参数的对手而训练的,然后根据一个强敌在同一空间中能够发现的最坏情况来判断。 我们设计了一个Simple-PAT算法,实现这一对战游戏,在参数空间上以零等CMA-ES优化. 在PAL-Dojo的四项任务中,Simple-PAT比统一训练和强力再加权变体更强. 交叉评价结果表明,各种培训运行之间有共同的结构,有时被黑盒优化者错过。 今后的工作可能利用这一结构产生更强大的对手和更强大的模式。

blocks.en: Appendix A Hyperparameters

blocks.en: • Training: each model is trained for 20,000 steps at a batch size of 256. • Models: for normals and chair tasks we train small unets around 7.5M and 7.8M parameters. They consist of standard blocks with two 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions followed by a GroupNorm and ReLU. We select GroupNorm instead of BatchNorm since our custom sampling procedure may affect the batch statistics. The pose network has a similar structure, but with global average pooling and an output head instead of upsampling layers. Consequently, the pose network has only 5.01M parameters. • Optimizers: we use Adam with a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} or Muon with a learning rate 0.02 0.02 . Muon is applied to the matrix and convolution parameters except the output head, and Adam is applied to the remaining parameters. Every training method uses Muon besides “Uniform (Adam)”. We use a cosine learning rate schedule with a warmup of 200 steps. • Simple-PAT: We use k = 16 k=16 , λ = 14 \lambda=14 and n 0 = 32 n_{0}=32 . Hence, each batch is composed of 32 uniform samples and 14 samples from 16 CMA-ES instances. blocks.en: Previous studies ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Vasudeva et al., 2025 ) have found that the Muon optimizer learns rarely-seen training data better than Adam. Consequently, models trained with Muon might exhibit improved robustness. We evaluate this on the normal estimation task using 15 seeds for each combination of optimizer (Muon or Adam) and training method (uniform or Simple-PAT). In Figure 6 we display these results. On the test-set maximum, Muon reduces the error by 5.1 degrees with uniform training and 2.3 degrees with Simple-PAT. When evaluating the worst case, Muon displays a significant improvement for uniform training but not Simple-PAT. This may be an issue of statistical power. Alternatively, Simple-PAT may concentrate sampling near the worst case. Then, these cases are no longer rare and Muon’s advantage over Adam may be lessened.
blocks.zh: 以往的研究(Wang等,2025b;Vasudeva等,2025)发现,穆恩优化者学习的训练数据很少比亚当好. 因此,经过穆恩培训的模型可能显示出更强的活力。 我们利用15个种子来评估正常的估算任务,这些种子用于优化者(Muon或Adam)和训练方法(统一或简单PAT)。 在图6中,我们显示了这些结果。 在测试-设定最大时,穆恩通过统一训练将出错减少5.1度,用Simle-PAT减少2.3度. 在评价最坏的情况时,穆恩对统一训练表现出了显著的改进,但并非简单的PAT. 这可能是统计能力的问题。 或者,简单的PAT可以集中采样到最坏的情况。 穆恩对亚当的优势可能会减弱。

blocks.en: When designing procedural generators, the searchability of the space impacts both the efficacy of the Simple-PAT algorithm and the evaluation. Here we present results using prototype versions of the environments described in the paper. These environments differ from the versions described in Section 3 in the following ways:
blocks.zh: 在设计程序生成器时,空间的可搜索性既会影响Simple-PAT算法的功效,也会影响评价. 在这里,我们利用文件所描述的环境的原型介绍结果。 这些环境与第3节所描述的版本有如下不同:

blocks.en:
• Object and room color. In the prototype chair environments, each object’s color was a hash of the slot’s other parameters (position, scale, appearance, yaw and tilt), and the floor and wall colors were a hash of the room dimensions and camera azimuth. Any change to those parameters therefore redrew the colors in a seemingly random pattern. In the final environments, object color depends only on that object’s appearance parameter, and room appearance is a single parameter. • Object class. The prototype chair environments selected objects through shared composition and permutation parameters, so one parameter could exchange the objects in several slots at once. The final environments give each slot its own class parameter. • Body pose. The prototype pose environment chose a stance with a discrete selector parameter and drew the body from a separate PCA model for each stance. The final environment uses a single archetypal model that allows continuous interpolation between all poses. • Dimension. Chair-simple grows from 11 to 13 dimensions, chair-full from 54 to 69
and pose from 44 to 49. Training, search, and evaluation of the prototype environments follow the same protocol described in the main paper with very minor implementation differences 3 3 3 In the prototype experiments, the pose loss computed the root-relative joint positions in bf16 instead of fp32 . In the prototype runs, a Simple-PAT search instance was replaced with an instance initialized from the farthest of 32 uniform draws from the other members’ means; in the final runs it is initialized from a uniformly random point. This change was made for simplicity. .
